ctbids-47872-5567365.description:
A 5-piece collection of vintage and modern women's wristwatches, featuring a solid 14K gold mechanical timepiece alongside gold-filled, open-cuff, and everyday quartz styles.
The centerpiece is a vintage Swiss-made Chalfont 17 Jewels square mechanical watch featuring a red second hand, Incabloc shock protection, a back case stamped "14KT GOLD" (solid 14k gold case), and a Speidel stretch expansion band; watch and band weigh 19.6 grams combined on the scale. The lot also includes a vintage marquise-shaped mechanical watch with a gold-tone textured dial, a case back stamped "10K GOLD FILLED", and a Speidel USA expansion band (weighing 15.5 grams combined). Completing the collection are an Eikon open-cuff watch set in a brown faux-tortoiseshell band stamped "Stainless Steel Back" and "Singapore Movt", a round two-tone watch with raised hour markers on a flexible expansion band, and a classic quartz watch with a white dial, black Arabic numerals, and a black stitched leather-look strap.
All watches are sold untested for functionality or timekeeping accuracy. Gold content marks apply strictly to watch cases as stamped; expansion bands, movement parts, and non-gold watches are base metal, gold-filled, or stainless steel as marked. Please review all photos for surface wear, crystal scratches, tarnish, and overall cosmetic condition. Included are only the 5 watches shown.
